role: XCUITest coverage of the Record tab: the session chooser's three cards (Daily, Extended, Nap), the no-strap connect panel's 'Scan for Devices' (or Bluetooth-denied banner), and scrolling the panel without a crash.

units.does: Sets continueAfterFailure=false, creates XCUIApplication, appends launch arguments -UITests-FreshInstall and English locale (UITestLanguage.english), launches the app (the app wipes onboarding/disclaimer/paywall flags, settings files and the session archive via AppLaunchRecovery.resetUITestStateIfRequested) and walks every first-run gate with UITestLaunch.toMainUI, ignoring its Bool result; then navigates to the Record tab.
units.entry: XCTest runner: setUp before each test in the class

units.does: Releases the XCUIApplication (app = nil); does not terminate the app.
units.entry: XCTest runner: tearDown after each test in the class

units.does: Opens the Record tab through UITestNav.selectTab (tab.record identifier, 'Record' title fallback; polls hittability, taps, confirms the tab's content identifier appeared) and asserts it returned true, dumping the screen on failure.

For each of 'Daily', 'Extended', 'Nap', asserts a button whose label begins with that word (the session card's 'X session — subheading' accessibility label) appears within UITestTiming.s(5). Pins the three cards under the chooser header that EmuquUITests.testRecordViewShowsSessionSelector covers.
units.entry: XCTest runner: test method on an XCTestCase subclass

branches.cond: for each of Daily, Extended, Nap
branches.effect: assert a button labelled with that type exists

units.does: Asserts the connect panel's own no-strap affordance: a button labelled exactly 'Scan for Devices' within UITestTiming.s(8), or (Bluetooth access denied) the static text 'Bluetooth access is off'.
units.entry: XCTest runner: test method on an XCTestCase subclass

branches.cond: Scan for Devices button appears, else Bluetooth-off text exists
branches.effect: either passes; neither fails the assertion

units.does: Asserts a scroll view appears within UITestTiming.s(3), swipes it up 4 and down 4 times, then asserts the app is still runningForeground and the tab bar exists.
units.entry: XCTest runner: test method on an XCTestCase subclass
